bootstrap.caveat: Twelve observations. These quantiles describe the spread this sample implies under resampling; they are not a significance test.

LOOSER_1_TICK.label: close below prior low, one tick of tolerance

STRICT_1_TICK.label: close below prior low by at least one tick

STRICT_0P01_ATR.label: close below prior low by at least 0.01 ATR

STRICT_0P02_ATR.label: close below prior low by at least 0.02 ATR

STRICT_0P05_ATR.label: close below prior low by at least 0.05 ATR
